# Meta

English · [Русский](../ru/companies/meta.md) · ← [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md)

Big Tech · International · Loop reviewed 2026-09-26

Structured loops with published preparation guides. Recent reports describe an AI-assisted coding round for engineering managers and live prototyping in AI product manager interviews.

## Roles covered

- **AI Leadership:** Engineering manager, AI product manager (senior to group), Technical program manager

## Interview loop

| Stage | What happens | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Engineering manager initial interview | A 45-minute conversation with a software engineering manager covering both technical and management skills. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Preparing for Your Initial Interview (software engineering managers)](https://www.metacareers.com/SWE-L-prep-initial/), Meta Careers, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| Technical program manager loop | Five conversations with technical program managers and cross-functional team members. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[Preparing for Your Interviews at Meta (technical program managers)](https://www.metacareers.com/tpm-prep-onsite/), Meta Careers, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| Engineering manager report (M1) | Screening with a behavioral round and a system design round chosen from ML, software or product; the main loop had ML system design, a project deep dive, team management, behavioral questions and an AI-assisted coding round. | 🗣 candidate report<br>[Meta Engineering Manager (M1) Interview Experience](https://www.tryexponent.com/experiences/meta-facebook-engineering-manager-interview-916dc8), Aced (formerly Exponent), candidate report, retrieved 2026-09-26 |
| AI product manager report (level unverified) | Product sense and analytical phone screens, then an hour split between product sense and live prototyping in a Llama-based vibe-coding tool, with follow-ups on retrieval, latency, inference cost and token efficiency. | 🗣 candidate report<br>[Meta Product Manager, AI Interview Experience (level unverified)](https://www.tryexponent.com/experiences/meta-facebook-product-manager-interview-618bfd), Aced (formerly Exponent), candidate report, retrieved 2026-09-26 |

**Coding:** varies by role. Engineering managers may get an AI-assisted coding round ([Meta Engineering Manager (M1) Interview Experience](https://www.tryexponent.com/experiences/meta-facebook-engineering-manager-interview-916dc8), Aced (formerly Exponent), candidate report, retrieved 2026-09-26)

## Questions reported for Meta

### [LLM fundamentals](../themes/llm-fundamentals.md)

- **Compare multi-head, multi-query and grouped-query attention in quality and serving memory.**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether shared keys and values are distinguished from query heads.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - MHA uses separate KV heads; MQA shares one; GQA shares within groups.
    - Relate KV-head count to cache size and memory reads.
    - Discuss quality evaluation and the need to train or adapt the checkpoint.
  - Read: [GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13245) (Ainslie et al., arXiv)
- **Explain rotary position encoding and the trade-offs of interpolation when extending context beyond training lengths.**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether a longer accepted input is distinguished from reliable long-context reasoning.
- **What objectives and data distinguish pretraining, instruction tuning and preference optimisation?**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether the candidate can identify what each stage can and cannot change.
- **Explain the two branches of SwiGLU and the parameter and compute trade-offs against a conventional feed-forward block.**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether gated activations are explained beyond their name.

### [Inference, serving and cost](../themes/inference-economics.md)

- **Compare tensor, pipeline, data, sequence and expert parallelism for a large model deployment.**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †, [Google and Google DeepMind](google.md) †, [Meta](meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether communication patterns and memory limits determine the choice.

### [Safety, security and governance](../themes/safety-security-governance.md)

- **Design a system for detecting harmful content in Facebook and Instagram uploads.**
  - System design · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether you combine detection, review and appeals at the required scale.

### [Multimodal and voice](../themes/multimodal-voice.md)

- **Compare projection layers, cross-attention and token-based integration for giving a language model access to images.**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether image encoding is separated from cross-modal fusion.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Separate the vision encoder from the interface to the language model.
    - Compare projected image tokens with cross-attention to visual features.
    - Discuss visual token budget, spatial detail and training alignment.
  - Read: [Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.14198) (Alayrac et al., arXiv)
- **What architectural and data choices change when a vision-language model must reason over video rather than isolated images?**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether temporal information and sampling cost are addressed.

### [AI system design](../themes/ai-system-design.md)

- **Design a moderation system that combines specialist classifiers and LLMs while controlling delay and review workload.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether risk classes, escalation and false decisions shape system design.
- **Design a streaming chat service for hundreds of millions of users, including capacity, conversation storage and graceful overload behaviour.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Anthropic](anthropic.md) †, [Google and Google DeepMind](google.md) †, [Meta](meta.md) †, [OpenAI](openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether scale assumptions lead to explicit capacity and reliability decisions.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Estimate concurrent streams, token demand and storage from declared traffic assumptions.
    - Separate admission control, inference scheduling and durable conversation state.
    - Plan capacity headroom, cancellation, overload rejection and recovery from partial failure.
  - Read: [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google) · [Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06180) (Kwon et al., arXiv)

### [AI product strategy and metrics](../themes/ai-product-strategy.md)

- **Notification engagement rises while total time spent remains flat. How would you interpret that result?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) 🗣
  - Tests: Whether you distinguish substitution, measurement artifacts and real user value.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Check definitions, exposure, cohorts and the experiment setup.
    - Test whether notifications shift existing activity or create valuable new actions.
    - Include opt-outs, satisfaction and longer-term effects before deciding.
  - Read: [Measuring the User Experience on a Large Scale: User-Centered Metrics for Web Applications](https://research.google/pubs/measuring-the-user-experience-on-a-large-scale-user-centered-metrics-for-web-applications/) (Rodden, Hutchinson and Fu, Google Research)
- **Design a product connecting local tradespeople with customers.**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) 🗣
  - Tests: Whether you reason about both sides of a marketplace and initial liquidity.
- **A new service grows while Facebook monthly active users decline. How would you assess whether the service is succeeding?**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) 🗣
  - Tests: Whether you investigate portfolio effects instead of reading one metric in isolation.
- **Design a volunteer-matching product and explain how it gets through cold start.**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) 🗣
  - Tests: Whether you make the first useful matches possible before scale arrives.

### [Programmes and delivery](../themes/program-delivery.md)

- **Describe a large cross-functional project, including ambiguity, roadblocks and delays.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Meta](meta.md) 🗣
  - Tests: Whether your delivery method adapts to changing information and dependencies.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Map deliverables and dependencies to accountable owners.
    - Explain how you detected a blockage and changed the plan or escalation path.
